_readme: The retail shirts on skrewu.com — the shop the nav points at. This replaces the storefront that used to live on Manus. Add a shirt to the `shirts` array and it shows up; there is no build step and no deploy hook, the page reads this file at load. Sizes are handled by Stripe, not here: add a size dropdown to the Payment Link (Stripe calls it a custom field) and the choice arrives with the order. Sold-out is `sold: true` — keep the entry rather than deleting it, so the link you posted still leads somewhere honest.

_shape.name: What it's called
_shape.blurb: One line. What it is, what it's printed on.
_shape.image: Public image URL — upload to the site-assets bucket in Supabase and paste the public URL
_shape.paymentLink: Stripe Payment Link, or null until you make one
